findings.label: 8.1 student read routes not hardened to latestPublishedPublication
findings.detail: GET /me/results and GET /me/results/:examId still resolve via the max-version latestPublication helper rather than the status-filtered latestPublishedPublication the slice added for finding 3 / NFR-4. Since 8.2 makes SUPERSEDED a written state, a stray SUPERSEDED row at max version could in theory leak to a student on these two paths. Non-blocking: these lines are unchanged by the 8.2 diff, the happy path is correct, and the migration backfill plus the flipped.count===1 single-PUBLISHED-max invariant protect against the anomalous state. Recommend switching both routes to latestPublishedPublication for consistency with the slice's own access-control posture.
